Training Tips
  • Choose weight so the last 2 reps require real effort
  • Rest 45–60 seconds between sets to keep heart rate elevated
  • 5 min treadmill warm-up before every session — mandatory
  • 5–10 min recumbent bike after strength burns remaining glycogen
  • Click any exercise to jump straight to the log
